title: Apollo 12 landed near a robot on the Moon
description:
The APOD 3D picture is made from two photos taken from slightly different spots, like your two eyes. Pete Conrad walked less than 200 metres to Surveyor 3.
NASA picture: JSC, S69-57076. Lunar Orbiter 3 photo of the Apollo 12 site.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Kevin Frank: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-14-apollo-12-and-surveyor-3/. To use it, please ask the owner.
